name: shadcn/ui
distribution: copy-paste: the CLI adds component source files to your repo
a11y: Built on Base UI or Radix UI primitives; in the cloned repo, apps/v4/registry references @base-ui/react in 48 files and @radix-ui/react-* in 1 file
styling: Tailwind CSS with CSS variables for theming
use_when: You want the component source in your repo and a Tailwind-based set you can edit directly
avoid_when: You want versioned library updates without copied code to maintain

name: Base UI
a11y: Accessibility-focused headless components (repo describes them as accessible); WAI-ARIA conformance not separately tested
styling: Unstyled; you supply CSS or Tailwind
use_when: You want unstyled accessible primitives with full styling control
avoid_when: You need the old name: @base-ui-components/react is deprecated in favor of @base-ui/react

name: Radix UI Primitives
distribution: npm package (unified radix-ui package, or per-component @radix-ui/react-* packages)
a11y: Primitives designed around WAI-ARIA patterns (repo claim; not separately tested)
use_when: You need unstyled, composable primitives and are building on the shadcn stack
avoid_when: You want pre-styled components out of the box

name: Sonner
styling: Ships its own stylesheet (package dist/styles.css) and theme props
use_when: You need stacked, transient toast notifications with a small API
avoid_when: You need persistent inline alerts rather than toasts

name: Vaul
avoid_when: The README states the repo is unmaintained (last commit 2025-10-03)

name: cmdk
a11y: README describes it as usable as an accessible combobox
styling: Unstyled; style through documented CSS selectors
use_when: You need a searchable command palette or filtered command list
avoid_when: You only need a plain select menu

name: NumberFlow
use_when: Numbers that change and should animate between values (counters, prices)

name: Magic UI
distribution: copy-paste: CLI and shadcn-compatible registry.json (260 items in the cloned repo)
use_when: Animated landing-page elements you will copy and own
avoid_when: You need audited accessibility without reviewing the copied code

name: Aceternity UI
distribution: copy-paste via CLI (npm package description: adds components to your apps)
avoid_when: Official source not confirmed: the npm package has no repository field and no repo was reachable

name: 21st.dev
distribution: CLI that searches and installs components from the 21st.dev catalog
use_when: You want to search and install community components from the terminal
avoid_when: Source repository not verified (npm has no repository field); review installed code like any third-party code

name: React Bits
distribution: copy-paste via shadcn and jsrepo registries (npx shadcn@latest add @react-bits/...)
use_when: Visual effects and animated text inside your own apps
avoid_when: You need to sell or redistribute the components; the Commons Clause forbids it

name: React Aria Components
a11y: Built on the React Aria hooks (Adobe); targets WAI-ARIA patterns and internationalization
use_when: Accessible, internationalized complex widgets such as date fields and comboboxes
avoid_when: You want ready-made visual components rather than primitives

name: Motion
avoid_when: A few CSS transitions are enough

name: Framer Motion
distribution: npm package (same repository and version line as motion)
use_when: Existing code that already imports framer-motion
avoid_when: New projects where the motion package is the documented entry point

name: GSAP
license: GreenSock Standard 'no charge' license (not SPDX; see gsap.com/standard-license)
avoid_when: Simple UI transitions; confirm the standard license covers your use first

name: RareUI
distribution: copy-paste via the shadcn CLI registry and the rareui CLI
use_when: Animated Tailwind components you will use in your own apps
avoid_when: You need to sell the components; the Commons Clause forbids it
